critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py L134 - BankAccountUpdate.account_name is Optional[str]=None while BankAccountCreate.account_name is required str. If admin PUTs with account_name='' the model_dump-filter (v is not None) will pass empty string through unchanged; PUT path does not re-run the strip() validation that POST does. Add same non-empty-strip check to update_bank_account.

backend/server.py L1093 - Backfill 'USDC name USD Coin -> USD Circle' runs on every startup as a blanket update_many. Idempotent but does a DB write each boot; guard with a version flag like the transaction_types reseed.

backend/server.py L746-797 & L801-850 - Bank account import and companies import share ~40 lines of near-identical CSV/XLSX parsing logic. Extract to a shared `_parse_upload(file, required_columns)` helper to comply with DRY (>10 lines duplicated).

backend/server.py L1061-1068 - Transfer-types reseed inserts 'FX - Corporate Settlement' individually AFTER the reseed loop; the reseed_transfer_types flag path would already include it. The individual insert is defensive but if the version flag is set true the block at L1067 still runs and reinserts on every boot when missing - fine, but consider moving the corp-settle add inside the same reseed branch for clarity.

backend/server.py L802 - import_companies has no `db.companies.find_one({'name': name})` de-dup by name; only code is checked. Two rows with same name/different code will both be created. Consider dual-key uniqueness or accept as intentional.

frontend/src/components/DealFormFields.jsx L199 - `banks.find(b => b.name === bankName)` couples bank identity to display name. If two banks share the same name across regions this returns the wrong id. Prefer matching by bank id passed as prop.

frontend/src/pages/NewDealPage.jsx L47 - `isFxLocal = transfer_type === 'FX Local' || transfer_type === 'FX - Corporate Settlement'`. Variable name is misleading; rename to `isCounterpartyDeal` or drive off a boolean flag on the transfer_type entity from backend so future variants don't require frontend changes.

frontend/src/pages/ReferenceDataPage.jsx L235 - Dialog title falls back to `TABS.find(t => t.value === tab)?.label?.replace(/s$/, '')` which yields 'Bank' from 'Banks' etc., but for 'FX Client' the hard-coded ternary works only for 'companies' tab. For any future non-plural tab label this heuristic will produce wrong titles. Consider adding a `singular` field on TABS entries.
